notes.title: Core Break 1.2.0 – The System Overhaul Update!
notes.content:
Core Break 1.2.0 – The System Overhaul Update! 

This is the biggest Core Break update yet! We’ve fine-tuned the entire experience with major improvements, new features, and full Linux support.

[hr][/hr]

 🐧 Full Linux Support! 
No more workarounds—Core Break is now fully supported on Linux! Enjoy smooth gameplay on your favorite OS.

 🔊 Overhauled Audio System! 
We've rebuilt the sound engine from the ground up! Expect crisper weapon sounds, immersive environmental effects, and dynamic audio adjustments based on the action.

 🗺️ The New Map Feature! 
Lost in the chaos? Not anymore! The new interactive map helps you navigate the station and plan your escape more effectively.

 💥 Visual Enhancements! 
Explosions, lighting, and particle effects have been completely overhauled for a more intense and immersive experience. Core Break has never looked better!

 🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements! 

Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay.
Fixed AI glitches and improved enemy behaviors.
UI refinements for a cleaner and more intuitive experience.

[hr][/hr]

 Ready to test the new system? 
Update now and experience Core Break like never before!
